title: Web Developer & (SEO, GEO, AEO) Specialist
description: Hydromo looking for a skilled Web Developer & SEO Specialist responsible for developing, managing, maintaining and optimising multiple company websites across different web platforms. The candidate should have strong expertise in web development, UI/UX design, technical SEO, Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), website performance and hosting/server management. The role involves managing websites built using WordPress and other web technologies, developing high-converting advertising landing pages, resolving technical issues and ensuring websites follow the latest Google Search guidelines and web development standards. Key Responsibilities1. Web Development & Website Management Develop, design and maintain multiple company websites. Work across different web platforms and technologies, including WordPress, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and PHP. Manage WordPress themes, plugins, Elementor and custom integrations. Develop responsive, SEO-friendly and user-friendly website pages. Maintain website content, layouts, functionality and performance. Identify and resolve website errors, broken links, plugin conflicts and technical issues. Perform regular website backups, updates and security maintenance. Manage website migrations and platform integrations. 2. UI/UX Design & Website Optimisation Create user-friendly website interfaces and engaging user experiences. Design responsive layouts for desktop, tablet and mobile devices. Improve website navigation, page structure and conversion flow. Optimise layouts based on user behaviour and performance data. Develop website wireframes, landing page layouts and design improvements. Ensure consistent design standards across all company websites. 3. SEO – Search Engine Optimisation Execute complete On-Page SEO and Technical SEO activities. Perform keyword research and competitor analysis. Optimise meta titles, descriptions, headings, URLs and internal linking. Implement schema markup, structured data and XML sitemaps. Monitor indexing, crawling, rankings and organic traffic. Manage Google Search Console, Google Analytics and SEO tools. Identify and resolve technical SEO issues. Monitor and implement relevant Google Search algorithm updates and best practices. 4. AEO & GEO – AI Search Optimisation Implement Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) strategies. Optimise website content for AI-powered search platforms and answer engines. Implement Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) strategies. Improve brand visibility across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and other generative search platforms. Develop structured, authoritative and entity-focused website content. Implement relevant schema markup, FAQs and topical content structures. Monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions and referral traffic. 5. Hosting, Server & Technical Management Manage website hosting accounts, domains, DNS and SSL certificates. Troubleshoot hosting and server-side issues. Resolve website downtime, 500 errors, database errors and server configuration issues. Manage PHP versions, MySQL databases, cPanel and hosting configurations. Configure caching, CDN and website security. Monitor website uptime, server response times and resource usage. Coordinate with hosting providers to resolve technical issues. 6. Outlook & Business Email Management Configure Microsoft Outlook business email accounts. Set up email accounts across desktop and mobile devices. Configure IMAP, SMTP and Microsoft 365 email settings. Troubleshoot email delivery, authentication, synchronisation and connectivity issues. Manage email DNS records, including MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC. 7. Website Monetisation & Conversion Optimisation Identify opportunities for website monetisation. Implement and manage advertising integrations, including Google AdSense where applicable. Optimise website conversion rates and lead generation performance. Improve enquiry forms, CTAs and conversion-focused website elements. Monitor website revenue and monetisation performance. 8. Advertising Landing Page Development Develop high-converting landing pages for Google Ads campaigns. Create campaign-specific landing pages based on target audiences and marketing objectives. Implement enquiry forms, WhatsApp integrations and conversion tracking. Ensure landing pages are mobile-friendly and fast-loading. Collaborate with the digital marketing team to improve landing page conversion rates. 9. Website Performance & Core Web Vitals Improve website loading speed and overall performance. Monitor Core Web Vitals, including LCP, INP and CLS. Optimise images, scripts, CSS and JavaScript. Implement caching, lazy loading and performance optimisation techniques. Maintain mobile usability and website accessibility standards. Required Technical Skills Strong knowledge of web development and website management. Hands-on experience with WordPress and other web platforms. Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and PHP. Experience with responsive web design and UI/UX principles. Knowledge of CMS platforms, themes, plugins and custom integrations. Experience with hosting platforms, cPanel, DNS and server management. Knowledge of MySQL and database management. Strong understanding of On-Page SEO and Technical SEO. Knowledge of AEO, GEO and AI search optimisation. Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. Knowledge of schema markup and structured data. Experience with Microsoft Outlook and business email configuration. Knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads landing page development. Preferred Experience 2-3 years of experience in web development and SEO & AEO, GEO. Experience managing multiple business websites across different platforms. Experience in website migration, hosting configuration and troubleshooting. Practical knowledge of website performance optimisation and Core Web Vitals. Experience implementing SEO strategies based on evolving Google Search guidelines. Ability to independently manage website development and technical SEO activities. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Website development and maintenance efficiency. Website uptime and technical issue resolution. Website loading speed and Core Web Vitals. Organic traffic and keyword ranking improvements. Technical SEO audit score and issue resolution. AEO and GEO implementation and visibility improvements. Landing page development and conversion performance. Website security, backups and update compliance. Business email configuration and troubleshooting. Website lead generation and monetisation performance. Ideal Candidate: A technically strong professional capable of independently managing the complete website ecosystem, including web development, WordPress and other platforms, hosting and server management, UI/UX, SEO, AI search optimisation, website performance and conversion-focused landing pages. title: Full Stack Developer (MERN)
description: Role Summary Full Stack Developers deliver the product features of the SaaS platform end to end on the MERN stack: React front ends, Node.js APIs, data models and integrations. Three developers share the work; suggested focus areas are listed below and final assignments follow the program task plan. All three write production-quality, tested TypeScript and follow the Tech Architect’s standards. Key Responsibilities Common Responsibilities (All Three) Backend: Build Node.js/Express (or NestJS) services with schema validation (Zod/Joi), centralised error handling, structured logging with correlation IDs, and OpenAPI-documented REST endpoints. Frontend: Build React/TypeScript features with a shared design system, server-state management (React Query/RTK Query), route-level code splitting and accessibility. Data: Model MongoDB collections with Mongoose, design compound indexes and TTL rules, use transactions where needed, and write efficient SQL for reporting and billing data. Quality: Write unit, integration and contract tests; keep CI green; participate in code review and design review; fix defects from QA and beta. Migration: Support MVP customer migration with import tools and backward-compatible API behaviour. Focus A: Tenancy, Identity and Access Tenant context: Implement tenant resolution (subdomain/header/token claim), request-scoped tenant context, and automatic tenant filters at the data-access layer so cross-tenant reads are impossible by default. Provisioning: Build tenant onboarding and offboarding workflows, plan and feature flags, and per-tenant configuration. Authentication: Integrate OIDC/OAuth2 and SAML 2.0 SSO per tenant, SCIM user provisioning, MFA, JWT access tokens with refresh rotation, and session revocation. Authorisation: Implement RBAC with resource-level permissions, API keys with scopes, audit logs for security-relevant actions. Focus B: Billing and Metering Subscription: Integrate a billing provider (e.g. Stripe): plans, trials, upgrades/downgrades with proration, coupons, taxes, invoices, payment failures and dunning. Usage metering: Capture usage events (media minutes, storage GB, inference jobs) via Kafka/queue with idempotency keys; aggregate and report usage to billing; enforce quotas and rate limits with Redis. Webhooks: Process provider webhooks securely (signature verification, replay protection, retries) and reconcile billing state. Focus C: Media/Map Viewer and Admin Console Viewer: Build the results viewer: video playback with HLS.js/WebRTC, timeline scrubbing synchronised with telemetry, map layers and detection overlays using Mapbox GL, Leaflet, OpenLayers or CesiumJS, with vector tiles and clustering for large result sets. Real-time: Implement WebSocket/SSE updates for job status and live results. Admin: Build the tenant admin console: users, roles, SSO setup, plans, usage and audit views. Required Skills and Experience 4–7 years of full stack development; strong React and TypeScript. • Node.js/Express backend development with REST API design. • MongoDB data modelling, indexing and aggregation pipelines; solid SQL. OAuth2/OIDC authentication and authorisation patterns. Unit and integration testing (Jest/Vitest, Supertest); Git workflow and CI/CD. Understanding of web security basics (OWASP Top 10, CSRF, XSS, CORS, input validation). Preferred / Added Advantage Multi-tenant SaaS experience. Billing provider integration (Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora). Map or video UI libraries (Mapbox, Leaflet, Cesium, HLS.js). GraphQL, NestJS, Redis, Kafka/RabbitMQ. Docker and cloud deployment on AWS or Azure. Experience using AI coding tools with review discipline. Key Deliverables Tested, documented features per sprint. OpenAPI specs and API client updates. Tenant-isolation, billing and viewer test evidence. Migration import utilities and runbooks. Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent experience.
